quick_skim.title: KOOPMAN-Luenberger Observer Design for Nonlinear Systems with Application to the Monitoring of a Latent Thermal Energy Storage
quick_skim.abstract: State estimation for nonlinear dynamical systems remains a fundamental challenge, particularly when measurements are sparse and internal states are inaccessible. This work presents a KOOPMAN-based Linear State Observer (KOOPMAN-LSO) design framework that enables linear observer synthesis for nonlinear systems through KOOPMAN operator theory. The nonlinear dynamics are lifted into a higher-dimensional observable space using physics-informed basis functions, where a linear predictor with control is identified via extended dynamic mode decomposition with control (eDMDc). A discrete-time Luenberger observer is then constructed in the lifted space, and the observer gain is obtained through a dual linear - quadratic regulator (LQR) formulation to ensure stable and tunable estimation error dynamics. The proposed framework combines the representational capability of KOOPMAN lifting with the simplicity and computational efficiency of linear observer design, providing a systematic approach for nonlinear state estimation under limited sensing. Its effectiveness is demonstrated on a latent thermal energy storage (LTES) system based on phase-change materials (PCM), where internal temperature states are not directly measurable. Experimental results under varying operating conditions show accurate reconstruction of unmeasured states from limited output measurements, illustrating the potential of KOOPMAN-LSO design for practical nonlinear systems. The proposed approach achieves high-fidelity reconstruction with an RMSE as low as 0.0819 °C for the LTES outlet temperature and generally below 1.0 °C for observable internal PCM temperatures.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Presents a Koopman-based Luenberger observer for nonlinear state estimation, applied to latent thermal storage. Lifts dynamics to linear form via physics-informed basis functions, enabling observer design. Generic nonlinear estimation method transferable to battery SOC estimation.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对非线性系统状态估计难题，提出基于Koopman算子的Luenberger观测器设计框架。利用物理信息基函数将非线性动态提升到高维线性空间，通过eDMDc辨识线性预测器并设计观测器。在潜热储能监测中验证了估计精度，该方法可迁移至锂离子电池荷电状态估计等非线性状态感知任务。
